pr_summary: Fix CNSGAGenerator to maintain population_size invariant when handling DataFrames with duplicate/non-unique indices. The fix changes pop_from_data() to use positional index (i) instead of label-based index (ix[i]), and cnsga_select() to use .iloc[] instead of .loc[] to avoid selecting multiple rows for duplicate index labels.

notes: This is a Python optimization library (Xopt) that uses conda/mamba for environment management. The fix addresses a pandas indexing bug where duplicate DataFrame indices could cause incorrect row selection. The CI workflow uses mambaforge and runs on ubuntu-latest. The test patch adds test_cnsga_baddf() which tests the fix by creating DataFrames with duplicate indices and verifying population_size invariance.
